import sys
from fastapi_cli.config import FastAPIConfig
from fastapi_cli.discover import get_import_data, get_import_data_from_import_string
config = FastAPIConfig.resolve()
data = get_import_data_from_import_string(config.entrypoint, config.from_pyproject) if config.entrypoint else get_import_data()
print('CONFIG', config)
print('IMPORT', data)
from uvicorn.importer import import_from_string
app = import_from_string(data.import_string)
print('APP', type(app), 'root_path', repr(app.root_path), 'urls', app.openapi_url, app.docs_url, app.redoc_url, app.swagger_ui_oauth2_redirect_url)
def public(o):
    return [n for n in dir(o) if not n.startswith('_')]
def show(route, indent=''):
    kind = type(route).__module__ + '.' + type(route).__qualname__
    print(indent + kind, [c.__name__ for c in type(route).__mro__][:5], 'path=', getattr(route, 'path', None))
    print(indent + '  attrs', public(route))
print('same list', app.routes is app.router.routes, len(app.routes))
for i, route in enumerate(app.routes):
    show(route)
